##### Project general facts

Post Hotel & Residences by Elie Saab, restored by the prestigious A++ Group, revives an eighteenth‑century chalet icon with a blend of historic charm and contemporary refinement. The design embraces Human Sustainable Architecture, flooding light‑filled spaces with airy openness while preserving the original alpine silhouette. Signature Elie Saab sophistication threads through every detail, creating a distinctive aparthotel experience.

Guests and residents can glide into a magnificent indoor pool, unwind in a serene spa equipped with sauna and steam room, and stay active in a beautifully equipped gym and dedicated yoga haven. An exclusive ski simulator offers year‑round training, complemented by a lounge that houses ski and bike storage alongside rental services. A refined restaurant and club provide elegant dining and lively après‑ski moments, while a secure kids’ playroom ensures family comfort.

Interiors celebrate Elie Saab Maison’s bespoke elegance, showcasing exclusive pieces, warm natural woods and soft textures that bask in bright, sunlit ambience. Thoughtful design details balance cozy alpine charm with chic sophistication, delivering an atmosphere of refined comfort throughout each fully furnished residence. Modern finishing with high‑quality materials completes the upscale living environment.  

##### Location description and benefits

Andermatt is a picturesque mountain village nestled in the Urseren Valley, offering stunning natural beauty, authentic charm, rich history, and a wide variety of sporting activities that captivate visitors throughout the year. Set at the foot of four alpine passes, this hidden gem of the Swiss Alps provides a perfect blend of adventure and tranquility, inviting residents to embrace the great outdoors and rejuvenate their spirit in every season. From world-class skiing on pristine alpine slopes to scenic hiking, biking, and golfing amid breathtaking landscapes, the region offers an unparalleled lifestyle for nature enthusiasts and luxury seekers alike.

The village boasts a vibrant culinary scene with something to suit every taste, from five-star gourmet hotspots to quaint local eateries and cozy mountaintop restaurants that celebrate the essence of gastronomic delight. A rich tapestry of art and culture unfolds throughout the year, with concerts, festivals, and cultural events that ignite the senses and create lasting memories against the backdrop of the magnificent Alps. Seamless mobility and exceptional connections, whether by foot, car, train, or bike, allow residents to discover scenic routes and embrace the natural beauty of the Swiss Alps with ease and convenience.

The surrounding region offers a treasure trove of experiences, from the tranquillity of mountain trails and wildflower-filled meadows to the exhilaration of world-class ski slopes and golf courses that attract discerning travellers from around the globe. Proximity to major Swiss cities, including Zurich, Lucerne, and Bern, as well as international airports, ensures effortless connectivity while maintaining the serene seclusion of an alpine retreat. This distinguished location truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the timeless charm of a historic mountain village with the dynamic allure of Switzerland's most captivating landscapes and cultural treasures.
